item.description: Even as an evacuation order was lifted for some low-lying areas near Cheboygan Wednesday, concerns remain about high water across Northern Michigan. item.title: Community Calendar Report for Monday, April 20th, 2026
item.description: Water levels are slowly dropping at the Cheboygan Lock and Dam after crews successfully restarted the adjoining hydroelectric plant Friday. According to the Michigan Department of Natural Resources, turbines are now pushing about one-third more water through the system—an extra 2,000 cubic feet per second. item.title: Community Calendar Report for Earth Day, Wednesday, April 22nd, 2026
item.description: Water levels remain high across much of Northern Michigan, and while some areas are beginning to stabilize, impacts from the flooding are still widespread. In places like Black Lake and along the Cheboygan River system, some residents are only now able to begin recovery, while others are still dealing with standing water and limited access. […]
